title: [Dev-J] nsclient not uploading on cellular network
body:
Phone: Cubot Kingkong mini 3
Android 12
Build 18f01d7b5930252a01bdbda86d56a1af720a0aa0
NSCv1

Cellular upload is turned on, still no uploads. Hangs on `NSCLIENT do connect`
Turn on WIFI, and uploads work again.
All other apps work on cellular, like dexcom share.

Logfile:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/12bBRq8KJrAj6LPggCFOXGfjU-oErUE_H/view?usp=drive_link

comments.body:
No idea how this was possible, for dexcom share to work, but the APN selected by the phone was not correct. 
Apparently the phone picked the first APN matching network name, even if wrong provider.
